title: Used Car Inspection Tracking Log
subtitle: Used Vehicle Inspection: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Used Car Inspection Tracking Log covers vehicle identity, history representation, visible condition, system test, measurement, limitation, and purchase decision input. The vehicle inspection coordinator records Used Vehicle Inspection events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Used Car Inspection Tracking Log keeps Used Vehicle Inspection exceptions visible until the vehicle inspection coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Used Car Inspection Tracking Log at inspection facility, lift bay, controlled test route, and document review area. Document vehicle identity, history representation, visible condition, system test, measurement, limitation, and purchase decision input identity before Used Vehicle Inspection begins. Compare vehicle identity, history representation, visible condition, system test, measurement, limitation, and purchase decision input findings with stated Used Vehicle Inspection criteria; route unresolved Used Vehicle Inspection issues to qualified independent automotive reviewer. For Used Car Inspection Tracking Log, confirm requirements for Used Vehicle Inspection. Ask qualified independent automotive reviewer to review Used Vehicle Inspection conditions beyond the vehicle inspection coordinator's role.

sections.title: Tracking period and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Used Vehicle Inspection, identify responsible parties, inspection facility, lift bay, controlled test route, and document review area, and the linked vehicle identity, history representation, visible condition, system test, measurement, limitation, and purchase decision input source.

fields.label: VIN, plate, year, make, model, and mileage
History, title, service-record, and listing references

sections.title: Status events and next-control history
sections.guidance: Capture Used Vehicle Inspection facts for vehicle identity, history representation, visible condition, system test, measurement, limitation, and purchase decision input; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Used Vehicle Inspection tracked controls
items: Body, glass, structure, paint, and prior-repair indicators
Engine, transmission, cooling, fuel, and exhaust operation
Brakes, steering, suspension, tires, and wheels
Electrical, controls, safety features, and accessories
Road test, scan, leaks, measurements, and inspection limitations

sections.title: Status decision and next trigger
sections.guidance: For Used Vehicle Inspection, preserve each open variance with its current state, accountable owner, and next dated update. Vehicle Inspection Coordinator performs period review.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Finding presented as guarantee or valuation without basis
blocks.guidance: Pause Used Vehicle Inspection when identity, safe testing, access limitation, material defect, or communication boundary remains unresolved. Retain the available Used Vehicle Inspection proof and route unresolved vehicle identity, history representation, visible condition, system test, measurement, limitation, and purchase decision input scope to vehicle inspection coordinator.
